name: Modal
summary: A blocking dialog for a decision that must be made now — confirm an irreversible step, pick a date, the ⌘K palette. Focus moves in and stays in; Escape or Cancel returns it. Rare by design: the product's default is 'confirm nothing, Undo instead' (specs/HANDOFF.md), so most actions never open one. Not for information (Toast, Banner) and not for a form that fits inline.

trigger.intent: Optional. A Button that opens the dialog (DialogTrigger wires aria-haspopup="dialog" / aria-expanded and focus return). Omit when the dialog opens programmatically — the ⌘K palette — and control isOpen instead; focus still returns to the element that had it.

isOpen.intent: Controlled open state. Pair with onOpenChange.

onOpenChange.intent: Closed by any means: Escape, Cancel, a choice, the backdrop (when dismissable).

title.requiredWhen: aria-label is not given. Rendered as the dialog's heading (Heading slot="title") and read first.
title.intent: The accessible name AND the visible heading. For an alertdialog it is the question: 'Withdraw this application?'

aria-label.requiredWhen: title is omitted — the ⌘K palette ('Search and commands') has an input where a heading would be.

children.intent: ModalBody and ModalFooter (ModalHeader is rendered from title). The function form receives close() so footer buttons can dismiss.

role.intent: alertdialog for a destructive confirmation: screen readers announce it as an alert and read the title immediately. Everything else is a dialog.

size.intent: Max width 400 / 560 / 720 px (10 / 14 / 18 × size.target.lg). sm for a yes/no, md for the palette and a date pick, lg for a form. Always full-width minus the gutter on narrow screens.

padding.intent: Panel inset 16 / 24 px (space.inset.md / lg). The pattern chooses md on phone; Modal contains no media query (CONTRIBUTING).

isDismissable.intent: A click on the backdrop closes. false for a destructive confirmation (a mis-click must not dismiss the question) and for anything with unsaved input.

isKeyboardDismissDisabled.intent: Escape always closes unless this is set. Set it only when Escape would lose typed input, and then Cancel must be in the footer.

keyboard.action: Opens. Focus moves to the first focusable element inside, or to the dialog itself if there is none (docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md).
Cycle through the dialog's controls only — focus is trapped (2.1.2 allows it: Escape is the documented exit). The page behind is inert and hidden from assistive technology.
Closes and returns focus to the trigger (or to the element that had focus). Disabled only by isKeyboardDismissDisabled.
Activates it. The primary action is never auto-submitted by Enter elsewhere in the dialog.

a11y.name: From title — a real heading wired by aria-labelledby — or from aria-label when there is no heading. The type union requires one of the two.
a11y.announcements: role="dialog" (or alertdialog) with aria-modal="true". While open, the rest of the page is aria-hidden (React Aria ariaHideOutside) and body scroll is locked (usePreventScroll); both are undone on close. The title is read first; an alertdialog is announced as an alert.
a11y.targetSize: Footer buttons are Buttons (md 40 / lg 44); the close button, when present, is an icon-only Button at 40. The backdrop is a dismiss target only when isDismissable.

rules: Rare by design. The product confirms nothing it can undo (Undo toast instead). A Modal is for a decision that cannot be undone, needs input, or needs the user's full attention — and nothing else.
Focus moves in on open (first focusable, else the dialog), is trapped while open, and returns to the trigger on close. Never leave focus on body (2.4.3).

The 'focus' state is the dialog element itself holding focus — it happens when the dialog has no focusable child (a pure confirmation with the buttons rendered later, or an info dialog). It shows the same 2 px ring as every control, inset, so the trapped focus is never invisible (2.4.7).
The title is a real heading (Heading slot="title", rendered as h2) and the first thing read. A dialog without a title needs aria-label; the palette is the one case.
Footer order: Cancel first in reading order, the primary action last (trailing edge). One primary per dialog. Button labels are verbs — 'Withdraw application', never 'OK'.
Destructive confirmation = role='alertdialog' + the question in the title + isDismissable=false. A mis-click on the backdrop must not dismiss a question about something irreversible.
Never stack modals. A dialog that needs a second dialog is a flow, and a flow is a page.

The backdrop is color.backdrop — translucent, so the page stays visible underneath and the user keeps their place. Separation comes from the panel's surface and shadow.overlay, not from blacking out the page.

Never obscures focus (2.4.11): the dialog IS the focus. A Toast that fires while a Modal is open is still announced (its live region is outside the dialog and aria-hidden — React Aria hides it; accept that a toast during a modal is lost, and do not fire one).
No z-index token yet (PARKING.md): the Modal portals to the end of body after Toast's region, so it stacks above by DOM order. The first real stacking conflict adds the z.* scale.
Enter / leave: fade over duration.normal / duration.fast; the panel does not fly in. Under prefers-reduced-motion the duration tokens are 0 and the dialog simply appears.

examples.title: Destructive confirmation (alertdialog)
examples.code: <Modal trigger={<Button>Withdraw…</Button>} role="alertdialog" title="Withdraw this application?" isDismissable={false} size="sm">{(close) => (<><ModalBody>Orbit will not be notified. The stage becomes Withdrawn and the actions are archived.</ModalBody><ModalFooter><Button onPress={close}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="danger" onPress={() => { withdraw(); close(); }}>Withdraw application</Button></ModalFooter></>)}</Modal>

examples.title: Pick a date (from the Snooze menu)
examples.code: <Modal isOpen={picking} onOpenChange={setPicking} title="Snooze until">{(close) => (<><ModalBody><DateField label="Date" /></ModalBody><ModalFooter><Button onPress={close}>Cancel</Button><Button variant="primary" onPress={() => { snooze(date); close(); }}>Snooze</Button></ModalFooter></>)}</Modal>

examples.title: ⌘K palette (no heading)
examples.code: <Modal isOpen={paletteOpen} onOpenChange={setPaletteOpen} aria-label="Search and commands" size="md" padding="md"><ModalBody><CommandPalette /></ModalBody></Modal>
